explication: This repository is a catalog of deployment examples for the 1Password SCIM Bridge, not the bridge implementation itself. The principal workflow is choosing an infrastructure example and deploying it to run the shared SCIM container image; some examples also include Google Workspace configuration. The graph preserves the main documented platform options and notable beta and deprecated examples. No source excerpts were provided, so relationships are limited to those stated in the README; individual manifests’ configuration and runtime behavior are not inferred.
